name: AppFlowy-Certbot
description: Optional (TLS): Certbot/ACME automated certificate management for AppFlowy-Nginx. Obtains and renews Let's Encrypt TLS certificates using the HTTP-01 webroot challenge. Part of the AppFlowy Cloud stack.

paths.name: Let's Encrypt data
paths.description: Persistent storage for Let's Encrypt account keys and certificates. Must match the path mapped in AppFlowy-Nginx.

paths.name: Certbot webroot
paths.description: Webroot directory for ACME challenge files. Must match the path mapped in AppFlowy-Nginx.
